result.summary: The street features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a bus shelter, indicating some priority for non-motorized transit. However, the lack of a median refuge and the relatively wide crossing distance across multiple lanes increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two travel lanes and a bike lane without a central refuge island.

hazards.name: Pavement Cracking
hazards.description: Visible cracks in the asphalt within the crosswalk area may present a minor trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom center of the image within the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of formal crossing infrastructure on a wide residential street. A pedestrian is shown crossing at an unmarked location, facing significant visibility challenges due to intense sun glare and a lack of pavement markings.

hazards.name: Sun Glare
hazards.description: Intense direct sunlight creates a blinding effect for drivers, significantly reducing the visibility of pedestrians in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Upper center of the image, directly above the pedestrian.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: A pedestrian is crossing a wide street without any marked crosswalk or signage to alert drivers to their presence.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground where the pedestrian is walking.

hazards.name: Lack of Lane Markings
hazards.description: The absence of lane lines can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning, increasing risk for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Road surface throughout the foreground and midground.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a continental-style marked crosswalk to clearly define the pedestrian path and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing point to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Lane Striping
interventions.description: Add clear lane markings to organize traffic flow and narrow perceived travel lanes to encourage lower speeds.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and signalized pedestrian controls. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the relatively wide roadway lacks physical traffic calming measures such as curb extensions to reduce pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, the crosswalk spanning the main road.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to provide a 3-7 second head start for pedestrians before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and traffic signals, but lacks visible pedestrian-specific signals and has a wide roadway that increases exposure. While a sidewalk exists on one side, the overall environment is dominated by wide asphalt and lacks traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide expanse of the intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street on the right.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the crosswalk may block the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, along the curb before the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.
